summary: Iteration 58: Google Classroom-style Assignments Feature Testing - All tests PASS. Backend APIs for squadron/flight targeting, Q&A questions, instructors/mentors, submissions with answers, and grading work correctly. Frontend shows Classwork header, stream view with assignment cards, create dialog with targeting options, detail view with tabs (Instructions/Submissions/People), and all CRUD operations.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend assignments.py correctly implements CREATOR_ROLES check for exec_cadre, executive_staff, training_officer, commander, dcp
SQUADRON_FLIGHTS mapping correctly maps 6th_cts to [alpha, bravo], 21st_cts to [charlie, delta], 22nd_cts to [echo, foxtrot]
_get_assignees() correctly resolves target_type (all, individual, flight, squadron) to user list
_can_view_assignment() correctly checks creator, instructor, mentor, or assignee access
_user_role_in_assignment() returns creator, instructor, mentor, or student role
POST /api/assignments creates assignment with target_squadrons[], target_flights[], instructors[], mentors[], questions[]
GET /api/assignments returns my_role, instructor_names, mentor_names for each assignment
GET /api/assignments/{id} returns submissions[] and assignees[] for creators/instructors
POST /api/assignments/{id}/submit accepts answers JSON field for Q&A responses
Frontend AssignmentsPage.js correctly implements Google Classroom-style UI with stream cards
CreateAssignmentDialog shows squadron/flight checkboxes when target_type is squadron or flight
AssignmentDetailView shows Instructions/Submissions/People tabs with proper role-based access
SubmitDialog correctly sends answers as JSON string in FormData
GradeDialog correctly calculates and displays total score from rubric scores
